name: Giancarlo Devasini

lifetimeGiving.source: No personal charitable giving found in search results or Wikipedia biography; no personal foundation identified.

onTheRecord.finding: 2021: Bitfinex/Tether (of which Devasini is CFO/co-owner) paid USD 18.5M to settle the New York Attorney General's lawsuit over the use of Tether reserves to cover Bitfinex losses in 2018 (company-level settlement).
1995: accused of software piracy by Microsoft in Italy; agreed to pay a fine of one million lire to avoid prosecution (per Corriere del Ticino via Wikipedia).
Lived in Lugano 2017-2023; Tether signed an MoU ('Plan B') with the city of Lugano promoting crypto adoption - corporate/civic partnership, not charitable giving.

notes: Forbes real-time 9/20/26: $89.3B, #22 in world; Forbes editor note (Mar 2026) says he is chairman and estimated 45% owner of Tether; residence listed as Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, France (not Lugano); citizenship Italy; no Forbes philanthropy score shown.
